candidate_evidence.quote: Participants will receive PrEP (as part of their standard of care), motivational counseling, and PrEP adherence support.

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive PrEP (as part of their standard of care) and PrEP education during medical visits.

agents.drug_class_hint: antiretroviral HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis; not an antitumour agent; moiety inferred from tenofovir diphosphate outcome

coder_notes: HIV prevention trial; 'GBM' here means gay and bisexual men, not glioblastoma or anti-GBM disease. PrEP is not a registered intervention (all interventions are behavioral); listed because arms state participants receive it.
